description: Defines the EmailsDetailView class extending DetailView2, handling email detail view rendering, setup, and field population in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: EmailsDetailView
classes.description: A class extending DetailView2 to manage email detail view display and data population.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the detail view with module, focus, metadata, template, and focus creation options.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Populates the bean with request data and calls populateFields to handle special fields.

methods.name: populateFields
methods.description: Handles special email fields like from_addr_name, decoding HTML entities.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns the HTML output for the view, optionally showing the title and handling Ajax save.
